# DigiRoo — Awareness & Seasonal Content Calendar (Nov 2026 – Oct 2027)

Research date: 28 Oct 2026. Verification method: web search snippets. Each row shows the date, how the date is determined when it moves each year, a source URL where one was found, and a one-line DigiRoo content hook. **"Calc."** = computed by me from a stated rule, not yet published by the organizer. **Unverified** = no snippet confirmed the 2026/27 date.

Time-zone note: Bermuda is UTC-4 (AST), UTC-3 in DST; one hour ahead of US Eastern. Schedule posts for the US Eastern buying audience.

Legend of priority for DigiRoo: ★★★ = build a campaign; ★★ = post 1–3 pieces; ★ = opportunistic single post.

## Recurring-rule cheat sheet (for next year's refresh)
- Screen-Free Week: week starting the first Monday of May ([National Today](https://nationaltoday.com/screen-free-week/)); confirm at screenfree.org (Fairplay).
- Digital Wellness Day: first Friday of May (pattern from 2023); confirm at digitalwellnessinstitute.com.
- Global Day of Unplugging: first weekend of March, sundown Fri to sundown Sat ([KOBI5](https://kobi5.com/?p=268318)); confirm at unplugcollaborative.org.
- World Spine Day: Oct 16 fixed; theme announced by WFC each summer.
- National Chiropractic Health Month, National PT Month, Children's Health Month, Global Ergonomics Month: all October, fixed.
- Correct Posture Month: May, fixed. Scoliosis Awareness Month: June, fixed; International Scoliosis Awareness Day last Saturday of June.
- National School Backpack Awareness Day: third Wednesday of September (AOTA).
- Safer Internet Day: Tuesday of the second week of February (EU Better Internet for Kids).
- Children's Mental Health Week (UK): first full week of February (Place2Be).
- Bermuda Day: observed the Friday before the last Monday in May (traditional date May 24). Cup Match: Thursday + Friday closest to Aug 1 (Emancipation Day / Mary Prince Day). National Heroes Day: third Monday in June. Bermuda Ag Show: late April (Thu–Sat).
- US retail: Thanksgiving = 4th Thursday Nov → Black Friday (+1), Small Business Saturday (+2), Cyber Monday (+4), Giving Tuesday (+5). Prime Day: historically mid-July, moved to June 23–26 in 2026; Prime Big Deal Days: early October.

## Three planning notes
1. **Two anchor campaigns:** Back-to-school (mid-Jul → mid-Sep) and Q4 gifting (Oct → Dec 26), each supported by an awareness-month cluster (Oct: spine/PT/chiro/ergonomics; May: posture/digital wellness/screen-free). Everything else is a single post.
2. **Bermuda-specific dates are PR and community hooks, not sales drivers** (Bermuda Day, Cup Match, Ag Show). Use them for local press, school partnerships, and UGC that feeds the US-facing feed.
3. **Verify in advance:** Digital Wellness Day, Screen-Free Week, Global Day of Unplugging, Prime Day 2027, Bermuda school calendar 2026-27/2027-28, Ag Show and Carnival dates were not published at research time. Check organizer sites 8–10 weeks ahead.
